achievements.name: Opening Investigation
achievements.detail: Work through the first crime scene and the people tied to it.

achievements.name: First Psync
achievements.detail: Enter a Somnium with the Psync machine and wake the dreamer before the six minutes end.

achievements.name: Mental Lock
achievements.detail: Open a Mental Lock and continue into a deeper layer of that dream.

achievements.name: Time to Spare
achievements.detail: Clear any Somnium while the clock still has time remaining.

achievements.name: TIMIE
achievements.detail: Use a TIMIE so an action inside a Somnium costs less of the six minutes.

achievements.name: Aiba's Scan
achievements.detail: Use Aiba's Zoom, Thermo, or X-ray vision on an object during an investigation.

achievements.name: Flowchart Branch
achievements.detail: Finish a Somnium in a way that adds a separate route on the flowchart.

achievements.name: Polar Bear
achievements.detail: Clear the Somnium where a polar bear stands in the way.

achievements.name: Route Ending
achievements.detail: Follow one character route on the flowchart through to its ending.

achievements.name: Second Route
achievements.detail: Clear a second character route that the flowchart keeps apart from the first.

achievements.name: Third Route
achievements.detail: Finish the last of the three character routes.

achievements.name: Final Ending
achievements.detail: Reach the ending the flowchart opens only after the other main routes are finished.
